title: Lineage-Specific Gene Expansion and Atypical Expression Pattern of Feminizing Gene Transformer in Stag Beetles.
authors: Ohtsu, Itsuki; Kondo, Hayato; Chikami, Yasuhiko; Dohra, Hideo; Gotoh, Hiroki
one_liner_zh: 该文研究锹甲中性别决定基因tra的拷贝数扩张与表达模式，虽涉及转录因子dsx，但无蛋白-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，仅基因表达与进化分析，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: The molecular cascade of sex determination in insects exhibits remarkable diversity in its upstream factors while conserving the downstream doublesex (dsx) gene across various taxa. dsx encodes a transcription factor that undergoes sex-specific splicing, playing a central role in sex determination. This sex-specific splicing of dsx is generally regulated by the Transformer (Tra) protein. Functional Tra is exclusively expressed in females, governing the female-specific splicing of dsx and inducing feminization. Although the tra gene is widely conserved across various insect species, with the genome typically containing a single copy of the tra gene, it is lost or duplicated in specific taxa, resulting in lineage-specific variations in numbers. Given the flexibility of the tra gene number and meanwhile the deep conservation of its crucial function in sex determination across most investigated taxa, the tra gene has attracted attention as the key gene for evolutionary change in sex-determining mechanisms. In contrast to this conventional insight, unexpectedly, we discovered that the number of tra genes has expanded through gene duplication in stag beetles (Lucanidae, Coleoptera). In addition, we discovered that the tra gene in several species of stag beetles has the same splicing variant in both sexes. Our findings suggest that the tra gene in the Lucanidae family deviates from the basic pattern observed in other insects regarding copy number and expression profiles. The discovery of tra expansion and expression pattern divergence in the family Lucanidae may provide new insights into the evolutionary diversity of the sex differentiation cascade.
abstract_zh: 昆虫性别决定的分子级联反应在其上游因子中表现出显著的多样性，而在不同分类群中保守了下游的 doublesex (dsx) 基因。dsx 编码一种转录因子，经过性别特异性剪接，在性别决定中发挥核心作用。dsx 的这种性别特异性剪接通常由 Transformer (Tra) 蛋白调控。功能性 Tra 仅在雌性中表达，控制 dsx 的雌性特异性剪接并诱导雌性化。尽管 tra 基因在多种昆虫物种中广泛保守，且基因组通常含有一个 tra 基因拷贝，但在特定分类群中该基因会丢失或重复，导致谱系特异性的拷贝数变异。鉴于 tra 基因拷贝数的灵活性，以及其在大多数研究分类群中性别决定关键功能的深度保守性，tra 基因作为性别决定机制进化变化的关键基因而受到关注。与这一传统观点相反，我们意外地发现，在锹甲科（Lucanidae，鞘翅目）中，tra 基因的拷贝数通过基因重复而扩增。此外，我们还发现，在几种锹甲科物种中，tra 基因在雌雄两性中具有相同的剪接变体。我们的发现表明，锹甲科中的 tra 基因在拷贝数和表达谱方面偏离了其他昆虫中观察到的基本模式。锹甲科中 tra 基因扩增和表达模式分化的发现，可能为性别分化级联反应的进化多样性提供新的见解。
